tools.name: get_parcel_quote
tools.title: Get live US parcel shipping rates

annotations.title: Get live US parcel shipping rates

tools.description: Live shipping rates for one parcel sent from a US origin — inside the US, or to Canada, the UK, Germany or Australia — across USPS, UPS and FedEx. Describe the item in plain words and the packed box size and weight are estimated; give exact dimensions and weight to skip the estimate. Returns up to five purchasable services with the checkout total, the carrier cost beneath it and the SMKlog fee stated separately. Oversized, palletized or crated shipments are priced by a person: clients that declare the io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks extension get a durable task handle (poll it with tasks/get, answers usually take a few business hours); others get a pointer to the human review page. Shipping labels are bought on smklog.com, not through this tool. Choosing between the tools: use this one to answer what a shipment would cost; use create_checkout_link only once the human has settled on shipping this exact parcel, since it opens a payment page; use get_price_index instead for typical or historical prices, because it is free while this tool spends a rate-limited carrier call every time.

product.description: Plain-words item description, e.g. "65 inch flat screen TV in original box"

from_zip.description: Origin 5-digit US ZIP. The origin is always in the United States; there is no lane that starts abroad.

to_zip.description: Destination postal code. A 5-digit ZIP when to_country is US or omitted; otherwise that country's own postal code, e.g. M5V 2T6 for Toronto or SW1A 1AA for London.

to_country.description: Two-letter destination country. Omit for a domestic shipment. Sold online: US, CA, GB, DE, AU. Any other country is refused with international_unsupported_online rather than priced, so do not retry it with a different box.

quantity.description: How many identical parcels ship together, priced as separate labels. Defaults to 1.

weight_lb.description: Packed weight in pounds. Optional; estimated from the description when omitted.

length_in.description: Packed box length in inches. Supply all three dimensions AND weight_lb to skip the estimate.

outputSchema.description: Live rates for the shipment. Empty rates with mode "freight_manager" means a person prices it.

mode.description: Quote mode; "freight_manager" routes to a human review

package.description: The packed box the rates were computed for

service.description: Service name without the carrier prefix

retail_amount.description: Carrier retail counter price, USD; 0 when not published

delivery_days.description: Business days in transit when the carrier quotes one

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.title: Create a payment session for a shipping label

annotations.title: Create a payment session for a shipping label

tools.description: Prices the shipment live and returns a payment session for buying the shipping label: the amount, and a handoff URL that opens the SMKlog checkout prefilled with this shipment. The human confirms the contents certification and the carrier-adjustment consent there and pays on Stripe hosted checkout. This tool never charges anything itself — MPP intent "session", not "charge". Prefer get_parcel_quote while the human is still comparing options: this tool prices the shipment live as well, so calling both for one parcel spends two carrier calls and returns the same number twice. Reach for it only when the parcel is decided and the next step is paying. Side effect and limits, stated rather than left to the annotations: it writes a session record on our side, it is not idempotent, and calling it twice makes two sessions and spends two carrier calls. Nothing is reserved and no card is touched until the human pays, and the link simply reprices if it goes stale. It cannot complete a purchase on its own — the human confirms the contents certification and the carrier-adjustment consent on the page, and on the four international lanes fills in the customs declaration there too. A shipment our rules send to a person (freight, oversize, an installed lithium battery crossing a border) returns no session at all: quote it first if you want to know which case you are in.

from_zip.description: Origin 5-digit US ZIP. The origin is always in the United States.

to_zip.description: Destination postal code. A 5-digit ZIP when to_country is US or omitted; otherwise that country's own postal code.

to_country.description: Two-letter destination country. Omit for domestic. Sold online: US, CA, GB, DE, AU. On the four international lanes the human completes the customs declaration on the handoff page before paying, and duty is billed to the recipient on arrival (DDU) rather than added here.

quantity.description: How many identical parcels ship together, priced as separate labels. Defaults to 1.

service.description: Optional service to anchor the amount, e.g. "USPS Ground Advantage". Cheapest when omitted; the human can still pick any service on the page.

outputSchema.description: A payment session, not a charge: the amount and the handoff URL where the human pays. The amount is a live quote at this moment, not a hold or a reservation, and no money moves until the human completes the page.

method.description: Payment rails behind the checkout, e.g. stripe, card

amount.description: Live-quoted checkout total for the anchored service, USD

service.description: The service the amount is anchored to

handoff_url.description: Opens the SMKlog checkout prefilled with this shipment

identified_product_title.description: What the estimator understood the item to be

note.description: Standing caveats: live quote, human confirms consents and pays

tools.name: track_parcel
tools.title: Track a SMKlog shipment
tools.description: Track a shipment whose shipping label was bought on smklog.com, by carrier tracking number. Returns the current delivery status, the latest scan events and the estimated delivery date when the carrier reports one. Works for SMKlog labels only — it is not a universal tracker for arbitrary USPS, UPS or FedEx numbers, so a number from any other seller comes back not-found rather than as a status. Unrelated to the two pricing tools: it neither quotes nor spends quote allowance.

tracking_number.description: Carrier tracking number from the SMKlog receipt or label page

outputSchema.description: Current delivery status plus the scan timeline, newest first.

estimated_delivery.description: Estimated delivery date when the carrier reports one

events.description: Scan events, newest first, up to eight

tools.name: get_price_index
tools.title: US parcel shipping price index
tools.description: The SMKlog parcel shipping price index: a monthly repriced basket of six common boxes (1 to 20 lb) shipped from Newark, NJ to five US cities, quoted through the same live USPS, UPS and FedEx pipeline that prices real shipments. Returns the cheapest purchasable service per box and lane with every rate behind it, plus basket averages. Reference data for questions like "what does shipping a shoebox cost in the US right now" — reading it spends no quote allowance. For a price on a specific shipment, call get_parcel_quote instead.

month.description: Issue month as YYYY-MM. Omit for the newest published issue.

outputSchema.description: One published issue of the index: the cheapest service per box and lane with every rate behind it.

captured_on.description: The date every price in this issue was captured

origin.description: Origin of every lane, Newark NJ (07102)

basket_average.description: Mean of the cheapest rate across all thirty cells, USD

carrier_wins.description: How many cells each carrier priced cheapest

cells.description: One entry per box and destination

cheapest.description: The lowest-priced purchasable service for this cell

services.description: Every purchasable service for this cell, cheapest first

page.description: The published issue page on smklog.com
